Vexil Document Specification

Vexil (.vxl) is a high-density, context-preserving structured text format engineered for LLM context windows, deterministic parsing, and semantic chunking. It combines the readability of Markdown with strict single-pass stream guarantees.

Structural Overview

Vexil partitions documents into deterministic block nodes without lookahead buffers. Inline styling supports bold text, italic emphasis, inline code, strikethrough, and hyperlinks. Visual assets are referenced using media syntax: .

List Structures

Document hierarchies utilize strict two-space indentation increments for nested structures.

  • Unordered item at root level
    • Nested unordered child item
    • Another nested sibling item
  • Secondary root item

Ordered workflows support explicit indices and automatic counters:

  1. Initial installation step
    1. Nested sub-procedure
    2. Secondary validation sub-procedure
  2. Final deployment phase

Actionable items are tracked via deterministic task list states:

  • Implement single-pass block tokenizer
  • Add symmetric inline delimiter stack
  • Benchmark zero-copy stream chunker
